note: Lewis County TN does not publish zoning districts as a queryable service. County zoning is limited to state code outside Hohenwald city limits (lewiscountytn.com/zoning). The City of Hohenwald, the only jurisdiction zoning here, publishes its zoning map only as a PDF (hohenwald.com/pdfs/zoning_map.pdf). ArcGIS searches for Lewis County and Hohenwald found no zoning FeatureServer or MapServer. Only parcel data is offered commercially (paid).
